description:
Your own ad as the feed's first card, reviewed before payment: refused → `review` with reasons; approved → an x402 payment request; repeat it with `_meta["x402/payment"]`.

Returns `review`, `ad`, `message`.

hours.description: Hours it runs; 168 if left out

name: create_ad

amount_atomic.description: The price paid, in the token's smallest unit (USDC has 6 decimals: 3760000 is 3.76 USDC)

creative_id.description: The ad creative it shows (create_ad); null for a listing ad

ends_at.description: When it stops being shown (ISO 8601). Null until paid

hours.description: How many hours it runs, as bought

id.description: The ad's id, as list_ads shows it

listing_id.description: The advertised listing; null for a creative ad (create_ad)

network.description: The payment network, as a CAIP-2 id (eip155:8453 is Base)

starts_at.description: When it starts being shown (ISO 8601); a second ad for the same listing starts when the first ends. Null until paid

status.description: "active": paid, shown between starts_at and ends_at; "pending" or "unknown": payment sent, confirmation not yet found, it starts once found (call promote_listing again with the same payment to check); "review": being checked by hand; "failed": the payment did not go through, so the ad will not run

tx_hash.description: The payment's transaction on the network; null until it is known

ad.description: The ad bought; null until it is paid, and when the review refused it

message.description: What to tell the person: why it was refused, or what to do while the payment is confirmed

review.description: The review: approved, refused (with the reasons) or removed

creative_id.description: The reviewed creative, to pay for again with creativeId; null when a field was invalid (nothing stored)

permit_classes.description: Permit classes it falls in, such as cosmetics or finance: allowed, and recorded for eno's reviewers

reasons.description: Why it was refused; empty when approved

code.description: A stable reason code, such as banned_gambling or image_too_small

reused.description: True when this is the stored verdict for the same content within 24 hours (no new review)

reviewed_at.description: When it was reviewed (ISO 8601); null when nothing was stored

status.description: "approved": it can be paid for; "refused": it broke a rule (see reasons); "removed": eno took it down

title: Create your own ad
